title: PERFORMANCE PATCH TEMPLATE -- cue-driven live electronics for one mic

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Turn on audio. The mono mic input (adc~ 1) is always processed by EQ and a 4-band compressor.
NEXT button (or MIDI note 64 from a pedal) advances to the next cue. CUE shows the current number.
Each cue sets the delay, distortion and detune send levels and their settings.
A cue can also start up to three soundfiles at once.
Mixer faders: DRY, DELAY, DIST, DETUNE, FILES and MASTER, each with a level meter.
Buttons Input, Cues, Delay, Distortion, Detune and Soundfiles open each section's subpatch.
Input opens the 5-band EQ and the 4 compressor bands (Thresh, Ratio, Gain, Atk, Rel).

sections.heading: EDITING CUES
lines: Cues live in cue-data.txt, one line per cue, loaded into coll cue-data at startup.
Line format: delay send, dist send, detune send, delay ms, delay feedback, drive, detune Hz,
then three soundfile names (none = no file).

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: The processed input is shared on send~ proc-out; each effect picks it up with receive~.
Cue values fan out through named sends; send levels ramp over 50 ms to avoid clicks.
Compressor settings are kept by pattrstorage comp-state and restored on load.
